commands.command:
set -eu
install -d -m 700 /etc/nginx/tls
cat > /etc/https-cert-renew.conf <<EOF
SERVER_NAME=node1
SERVER_IP=$NODE_IP
VALID_DAYS=30
RENEW_BEFORE_DAYS=7
EOF
chmod 600 /etc/https-cert-renew.conf
cat > /usr/local/sbin/renew-https-cert <<'ANTRIEB_RENEW'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
. /etc/https-cert-renew.conf
CERT_ROOT=/etc/nginx/tls
CURRENT="$CERT_ROOT/current"
force=0
[ "${1:-}" = "--force" ] && force=1
renew_seconds=$((RENEW_BEFORE_DAYS * 86400))
if [ "$force" -eq 0 ] && [ -r "$CURRENT/fullchain.pem" ] && openssl x509 -checkend "$renew_seconds" -noout -in "$CURRENT/fullchain.pem" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  serial=$(openssl x509 -in "$CURRENT/fullchain.pem" -noout -serial | cut -d= -f2)
  printf 'UNCHANGED serial=%s certificate remains valid beyond renewal window\n' "$serial"
  exit 0
fi
umask 077
stamp=$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)-$$
newdir="$CERT_ROOT/releases/$stamp"
mkdir -p "$newdir"
openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:2048 -nodes -sha256 -days "$VALID_DAYS" \
  -subj "/CN=$SERVER_NAME" \
  -addext "subjectAltName=DNS:$SERVER_NAME,IP:$SERVER_IP" \
  -keyout "$newdir/privkey.pem" -out "$newdir/fullchain.pem" >/dev/null 2>&1
chmod 600 "$newdir/privkey.pem"
chmod 644 "$newdir/fullchain.pem"
openssl x509 -in "$newdir/fullchain.pem" -noout >/dev/null
openssl pkey -in "$newdir/privkey.pem" -check -noout >/dev/null
cert_pub=$(openssl x509 -in "$newdir/fullchain.pem" -pubkey -noout | openssl sha256)
key_pub=$(openssl pkey -in "$newdir/privkey.pem" -pubout 2>/dev/null | openssl sha256)
[ "$cert_pub" = "$key_pub" ]
old_target=''
[ -L "$CURRENT" ] && old_target=$(readlink "$CURRENT")
next_link="$CERT_ROOT/.current.$$"
ln -s "$newdir" "$next_link"
mv -f "$next_link" "$CURRENT"
if rc-service nginx status >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  if ! nginx -t >/dev/null 2>&1 || ! rc-service nginx reload >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    if [ -n "$old_target" ]; then
      rollback="$CERT_ROOT/.rollback.$$"
      ln -s "$old_target" "$rollback"
      mv -f "$rollback" "$CURRENT"
      rc-service nginx reload >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
    fi
    printf 'ERROR certificate installed but nginx validation/reload failed\n' >&2
    exit 1
  fi
fi
new_serial=$(openssl x509 -in "$CURRENT/fullchain.pem" -noout -serial | cut -d= -f2)
printf 'RENEWED serial=%s not_after=%s\n' "$new_serial" "$(openssl x509 -in "$CURRENT/fullchain.pem" -noout -enddate | cut -d= -f2-)"
ANTRIEB_RENEW
chmod 700 /usr/local/sbin/renew-https-cert
cat > /etc/nginx/http.d/https-8443.conf <<'ANTRIEB_NGINX'
server {
    listen 8443 ssl;
    server_name node1;
    ssl_certificate /etc/nginx/tls/current/fullchain.pem;
    ssl_certificate_key /etc/nginx/tls/current/privkey.pem;
    ssl_protocols TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3;
    location / {
        default_type text/plain;
        return 200 "node1 HTTPS certificate rotation service\n";
    }
}
ANTRIEB_NGINX
cat > /etc/periodic/daily/renew-https-cert <<'ANTRIEB_CRON'
#!/bin/sh
exec /usr/local/sbin/renew-https-cert
ANTRIEB_CRON
chmod 700 /etc/periodic/daily/renew-https-cert
/usr/local/sbin/renew-https-cert --force
nginx -t

curl --fail --silent --show-error --cacert "$cert" --resolve "node1:8443:$NODE_IP" https://node1:8443/
printf '%s\n' '--- final certificate ---'
openssl x509 -in "$cert" -noout -serial -subject -dates -ext subjectAltName
if openssl x509 -checkend 604800 -noout -in "$cert" >/dev/null; then printf '%s\n' 'valid_beyond_renewal_window=yes'; else printf '%s\n' 'valid_beyond_renewal_window=no'; exit 1; fi
printf 'tls_verify='; openssl s_client -connect "$NODE_IP:8443" -servername node1 -CAfile "$cert" -verify_return_error </dev/null 2>&1 | grep 'Verify return code' | tail -1
